title: Design System: Vem svarar för Acus?

display.purpose: Old-style serif for page-level questions and the centered home hero.

headline.purpose: Old-style serif for section arguments and major content headings.

home-chapter.purpose: A restrained chapter scale for the figures section.

scope.purpose: A compact serif scale sized to hold the legal clarification in four deliberate lines.

download-title.purpose: Introduces the full-width social artwork row.

body.purpose: Evidence-led prose, constrained to a readable measure.

label.purpose: Dates, sources, statuses, and compact navigation labels.

layoutMeta.grid: One reading column on phones; a two-track tablet tier from 700px for the registers whose columns can hold their content (route hero, research record); the complete 12-column publication grid from 840px. Max content width 1180px.

shadows.name: document-ambient
shadows.purpose: Separates the bounded publication canvas from the atmospheric field on wide screens only.

motion.name: control
motion.purpose: Colour and border feedback on controls and links.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: One-time fade-and-rise reading cue; disabled for reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The direct action pattern for sharing or continuing to evidence, with a 44px minimum touch target.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; padding:12px 24px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:0; background:var(--ink, #101829); color:var(--on-ink, #fffaf4); font-family:var(--font-sans, 'Geist Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size:.875rem; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:-.005em; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 140ms ease; } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--ink-hover, #263148); } } .ds-btn-primary:active { background:var(--ink-hover, #263148); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--edge, #1e6578); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The secondary action pattern, visibly available without competing with the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; padding:12px 24px; border:1px solid var(--hair, #d5c8bb); border-radius:0; background:transparent; color:var(--ink, #101829); font-family:var(--font-sans, 'Geist Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size:.875rem; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:-.005em; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease; } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:var(--wash, #ebe2d8); border-color:var(--ghost, #77675d); } } .ds-btn-ghost:active { background:var(--wash, #ebe2d8); border-color:var(--ghost, #77675d); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--edge, #1e6578); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Question Status Flag
components.description: A compact factual state marker for an unanswered question.
components.css: .ds-flag { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:4px 8px; border-radius:4px; background:var(--flag-wash, #dcebea); color:var(--flag, #1e6578); font-family:var(--font-mono, 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); font-size:.6875rem; font-weight:500; line-height:1.4; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-flag i { width:5px; height:5px; flex:none; background:currentColor; }

components.name: Citation Link
components.description: Publisher-named evidence link, preserving the distinction between reporting and primary material.
components.css: .ds-cite-row { display:grid; justify-items:start; gap:4px; margin:0; } .ds-cite-row>span:first-child { color:var(--ghost, #77675d); font-family:var(--font-mono, 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); font-size:.6875rem; line-height:1.5; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-cite-links { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:baseline; gap:8px; } .ds-cite-row a { position:relative; color:var(--faint, #725f54); font-family:var(--font-mono, 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); font-size:.75rem; line-height:1.5; letter-spacing:.01em; text-decoration:none; white-space:nowrap; border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair, #d5c8bb); transition:color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease; } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-cite-row a:hover { color:var(--ink, #101829); border-color:var(--ghost, #77675d); } } .ds-cite-row a:active { color:var(--ink, #101829); border-color:var(--ghost, #77675d); } .ds-cite-row a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--edge, #1e6578); outline-offset:3px; } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-cite-links { gap:16px 24px; } .ds-cite-row a::after { content:''; position:absolute; inset:-8px -6px; } }

components.name: Record Row
components.description: A border-delimited evidence row; this replaces decorative card grids throughout the site.
components.html:
?

What remains unanswered?

The question is stated plainly and linked to evidence.
components.css: .ds-record { display:grid; grid-template-columns:20px 1fr; gap:12px; align-items:start; padding:20px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair, #d5c8bb); color:var(--body, #3d3632); font-family:var(--font-sans, 'Geist Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-record-mark { color:var(--flag, #1e6578); font-family:var(--font-mono, 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); font-size:.8125rem; line-height:1.5; user-select:none; } .ds-record h3 { margin:0; color:var(--ink, #101829); font-size:1rem; font-weight:600; line-height:1.35; letter-spacing:-.01em; } .ds-record p { margin:8px 0 0; max-width:68ch; font-size:.9375rem; line-height:1.6; }

components.name: Timeline Docket
components.description: A chaptered public-record chronology with a recurring date axis, selective turning-point emphasis, and one conclusive present-state plane.
components.html:
The unanswered exchange

Parliament asks who authorised Acus. The answers stop short.

  1. 6 November 2025

    Written question 2025/26:167

    The question enters the public record.

  2. 19 November 2025

    The minister answers — without answering

    The timing and storage questions are not addressed.
components.css: .ds-docket { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(12,minmax(0,1fr)); column-gap:clamp(24px,3vw,40px); padding:48px 0 96px; border-top:1px solid var(--hair, #d5c8bb); font-family:var(--font-sans, 'Geist Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-docket>header { grid-column:1/5; } .ds-docket>ol { grid-column:5/-1; margin:0; padding:0; list-style:none; } .ds-docket li { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(8,minmax(0,1fr)); column-gap:clamp(24px,3vw,40px); padding:32px 0; } .ds-docket time { grid-column:1/3; color:var(--ink, #101829); font-family:var(--font-mono, 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); font-size:.8125rem; line-height:1.5; } .ds-docket article { grid-column:3/-1; } .ds-docket h2 { margin:0; color:var(--ink, #101829); font-family:var(--font-serif, Baskerville, 'Libre Baskerville', Georgia, serif); font-weight:400; font-size:clamp(1.65rem,2.5vw,2.35rem); line-height:1.12; } .ds-docket h3 { margin:0; color:var(--ink, #101829); font-size:1.0625rem; font-weight:600; line-height:1.35; } .ds-docket p { margin:8px 0 0; max-width:68ch; color:var(--body, #3d3632); font-size:.9375rem; line-height:1.62; } .ds-docket .is-turning { padding:48px 0; } @media (min-width:840px) and (min-height:700px) { .ds-docket>header { position:sticky; top:92px; } } @media (max-width:839px) { .ds-docket { grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:32px; } .ds-docket>header,.ds-docket>ol { grid-column:1; } .ds-docket li { grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:12px; padding:24px 0; } .ds-docket time,.ds-docket article { grid-column:1; } }

components.name: Documentary Pull Quote
components.description: A ministerial quotation paired with its documentary portrait; it stacks on narrow viewports and never crops the photograph.
components.css: .ds-quote { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.15fr) minmax(300px,.85fr); align-items:center; gap:clamp(32px,5vw,72px); margin:0; padding-top:clamp(28px,3.5vw,44px); border-top:1px solid var(--hair, #d5c8bb); } .ds-quote blockquote { margin:0; max-width:24ch; color:var(--ink, #101829); font-family:var(--font-serif, Baskerville, 'Libre Baskerville', Georgia, serif); font-size:clamp(2rem,3.5vw,3.25rem); font-weight:400; line-height:1.06; letter-spacing:-.032em; text-wrap:balance; } .ds-quote img { display:block; width:100%; height:auto; border:1px solid var(--hair, #d5c8bb); border-radius:0; filter:saturate(.9) contrast(.98); } @media (max-width:819px) { .ds-quote { grid-template-columns:1fr; } }

components.name: Press Card
components.description: Auto-height photographic coverage record with an approved publication mark and complete, unclipped context.

components.css: .ds-press { display:flex; min-width:0; flex-direction:column; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid var(--hair, #d5c8bb); border-radius:0; background:var(--card, #fbf8f2); color:var(--body, #3d3632); text-decoration:none; font-family:var(--font-sans, 'Geist Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); transition:border-color 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-press-photo { position:relative; aspect-ratio:16/9; overflow:hidden; background:var(--chalk, #e6ddd2); } .ds-press-photo>img { width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; filter:saturate(.72) contrast(.96); } .ds-press-body { display:flex; min-width:0; flex:1; flex-direction:column; padding:16px 20px 20px; } .ds-press-logo { width:auto; max-width:132px; height:35px; object-fit:contain; object-position:left center; } .ds-press strong { margin-top:12px; color:var(--ink, #101829); font-family:var(--font-serif, Baskerville, 'Libre Baskerville', Georgia, serif); font-weight:400; font-size:clamp(1.125rem,1.6vw,1.375rem); line-height:1.32; letter-spacing:-.012em; overflow-wrap:anywhere; } .ds-press small { margin-top:8px; max-width:68ch; color:var(--muted, #5d5048); font-size:.875rem; line-height:1.55; overflow-wrap:anywhere; } .ds-press em { align-self:flex-start; margin-top:auto; padding-top:16px; color:var(--flag, #1e6578); border-bottom:1px solid currentColor; font-size:.875rem; font-style:normal; font-weight:600; } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-press:hover { border-color:var(--ghost, #77675d); } } .ds-press:active { border-color:var(--ghost, #77675d); background:var(--wash, #ebe2d8); } .ds-press:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--edge, #1e6578); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Section Artwork Placeholder
components.description: A localized neutral-gray frame that reserves a section page's final campaign artwork aspect ratio and displays its recommended export dimensions.
components.css: .ds-art-slot { display:grid; place-items:center; aspect-ratio:4/5; min-width:0; margin:0; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid var(--hair, #d5c8bb); border-radius:0; background:var(--image-placeholder, #d8cdbf); color:var(--image-placeholder-ink, #493f39); } .ds-art-slot figcaption { display:grid; justify-items:center; gap:4px; padding:24px; text-align:center; text-wrap:balance; } .ds-art-slot span { font-family:var(--font-sans, 'Geist Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size:.9375rem; line-height:1.45; } .ds-art-slot strong { font-family:var(--font-mono, 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); font-size:.8125rem; font-weight:500; line-height:1.4; } .ds-art-slot small { font-family:var(--font-sans, 'Geist Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size:.75rem; line-height:1.4; }

components.name: Share Toast
components.description: Confirms that the link and summary reached the clipboard. Flat and square like every other notice; portalled to <body> so a transformed ancestor cannot re-anchor it away from the viewport.
components.html: Link and text copied. Paste it wherever you want to share.
components.css: .ds-toast { display: inline-block; max-width: 38rem; padding: 14px 20px; background: var(--ink, #101829); color: var(--on-ink, #fffaf4); border-radius: 0; animation: ds-toast-in 260ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; } .ds-toast__text { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Geist Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; text-wrap: pretty; } @keyframes ds-toast-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-toast { animation-duration: 1ms; } }

narrative.overview: A calm evidentiary campaign presented as one bounded editorial publication. Warm paper, old-style serif headlines, structural hairlines, source-level metadata and broad artwork fields make the unanswered questions feel civic, legible and difficult to ignore.
keyCharacteristics: A bounded paper canvas sits inside a restrained atmospheric field.
The home hero centers one large serif question above a wide 9:5 campaign artwork stage, with a read-first / share-second action pair between them.
Every section-page hero pairs its thesis with a reserved 4:5 campaign-artwork field.
A recurring 12-column evidence grid establishes recognizable alignment after the centered opening.
Evidence figures and sources remain verifiable public-record registers rather than dashboards.
A large Night Record footer turns the campaign question into the final statement.
Press coverage uses static photographic records with approved SVG marks and complete copy.

rules.name: The Calm Signal Rule
rules.body: Stronger blue communicates action or unresolved state without performing alarm. It may be used for links and focus, but never as decorative noise.

rules.name: The Evidence Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: A claim is sans; the evidence that locates it is mono. Do not reverse this relationship.

rules.name: The Line-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate information with a hairline or a tonal surface. Do not add shadows to cards, lists, buttons, or notices.

rules.name: The Plain Heading Rule
rules.body: Page and section headings stand on their own. Do not add eyebrow labels, decorative section numbers, or ornamental arrows.

rules.name: The Shared Axis Rule
rules.body: Narrow prose may retain a readable measure, but it sits asymmetrically inside the evidence grid rather than floating between full-width sections.

rules.name: The Adaptive Reading Rule
rules.body: Phones use one reading column, tablets introduce only the columns their content can support, and all viewport edges respect device safe areas.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Sharing offers exactly one control: copy the short summary and the canonical link together, then confirm in a toast. Per-network buttons are absent by decision, not omission — LinkedIn ignores every prefill parameter, so a network button can only hand over an empty composer. Masthead and hero share controls are jump links to that panel, never second copy controls.

rules.name: The Earned Hairline Rule
rules.body: A hairline or a tonal surface — not both, and never a rule that restates a separation something else already made. A rule is not earned when it sits at a ground change (the band or panel edge is the division), when it opens or closes a group the ground already bounds, or when the items it divides already carry ~64px of interval and their own left-hand marker. Chronology entries and the share panel are separated by spacing; chapters, the press transition, and the compact panel records keep their rules. When a rule is removed, close the interval it occupied — otherwise the gap reads as a hole rather than a separation.

rules.name: The Long Compound Rule
rules.body: Swedish sets the minimum width, not English. Compounds such as "Ansiktsigenkänning", "Analysplattformen", and "interpellationsdebatt" are single unbreakable words that can exceed a column sized against English. Any track holding a heading must clear the longest word it will ever receive; headings additionally carry `hyphens: auto` and `overflow-wrap: break-word` so no future word can collide with an adjacent column. Check Swedish before declaring a layout done.

rules.name: The Tablet Is Not a Wide Phone Rule
rules.body: 768, 810, 820 and 834 are the four widths most tablets open at, and all four sit below the 840px twelve-column threshold. A register earns the tablet two-column tier when both tracks stay wide enough for their content — the route hero and the research record do; anything with a serif title rail does not, because a ~200px track cannot hold “Analysplattformen”. Where a register stays on one column there, the prose still carries its own measure: a block that fills the shell at 834px runs to 85ch.

rules.name: The Height Is A Breakpoint Too Rule
rules.body: A phone held sideways is 844px wide and 390px tall. Any forced height, pinned element, or opening interval gated on width alone will be applied to it. Gate them on min-height as well.

rules.name: Hover Is A Capability, Not A Default
rules.body: Hover styling sits behind @media (hover: hover); on touch a tap otherwise leaves the control in its hover state until something else is touched. Controls that change on hover carry an :active equivalent so a press still acknowledges itself.

dos: Do use warm hairlines, measured whitespace, and a maximum content width of 1180px to make long material easy to verify.
Do center only the home opening; align route heroes, section rails, evidence fields, and press introductions to the shared 12-column grid.
Do use one reading column on phones, selective two-column registers on tablets, and the complete publication grid only when the content supports it.
Do respect safe-area insets at every viewport edge and keep interactive controls at least 44px.
Do use the 4pt component spacing scale, square structural edges, and role-based section padding.
Do preserve the supplied 9:5 Home artwork, 4:5 section-page hero slots, 3:2 Acus explainer slot, and both share-export ratios when replacing placeholders.
Do use the stronger teal consistently for actions, focus, unanswered questions, and the current political state.
Do show every press article with a photograph, approved SVG publisher mark, complete description, and direct external link.
Do use the same photographic press grid on Home and About so coverage reads as one system.
Do let headlines, summaries, publisher marks, and dates wrap without collision at every viewport.
Do honour reduced motion: reveal content must be visible without animation and instantly readable for reduced-motion users.
donts: Don't make it look like party-political propaganda.
Don't add social-justice-warrior signalling, moralising iconography, or outrage-first visual treatment.
Don't use the visual language of a SaaS technology company.
Don't invite whistleblowing, leaked information, source submissions, or private contact anywhere on the site.
Don't turn press coverage into a carousel or moving rail.
Don't use eyebrow labels, decorative 01/02/03 numbering, ornamental arrows, or text truncation.
Don't stack two full section paddings between adjacent modules.
Don't default unrelated content to equal-width compartments.
Don't add placeholders beyond the defined hero, Acus explainer, and social-export slots, and don't round structural record rows.
